hero.label: Supplement Routine Tracker
hero.title: Log supplements consistently with simple reminders.
text: Dose Easy helps you build a reliable supplement routine with dose logs, reminders, and daily checklists that keep your health habits visible and easy to follow.

items.title: Dose tracking
items.text: Track every supplement, dosage, and frequency without manually juggling multiple lists.

items.title: Reminder automation
items.text: Local reminders keep your routine on schedule, even when your day gets busy.

items.title: Adherence history
items.text: Review consistency over days and weeks so you can identify gaps before routines drift.

items.title: Export and review
items.text: Share or review dose logs in a clean format for personal tracking workflows.

items.title: Private by default
items.text: No accounts or sign up required and no telemetry from your health routine.

sections.title: Privacy
text: Dose Easy keeps dose records and reminders fully local. We do not sync your routine to the cloud, track your behavior, or deliver ads.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Install Dose Easy to track smarter and stay focused on what matters.
